what_happened: Research report states 'Five existing cases cover' the Tier-Justification fixture family in test-validate-artifact.sh; live count is 13 common_test_pass TJ assertions across 8 labeled case families (positive, negative, sentinel(i), sentinel(ii), mixed-honest, mixed-false-sentinel, skip-case __WHOLE_TREE__, skip-case prose sentinel). Also the candidate-list block is at lines 358-376, not ~353-376 (353 is the comment start). Both re-derived live at plan authoring; plan uses the live figures.

Every non-final phase's Tier Justification was measured live by sourcing suite-selection-lib.sh and running suite_selection_select once over that phase's whole Files-to-modify set before writing the line (including the mixed sentinel+suites output for the docs phase, where the sentinel was correctly omitted from the claim). The deployed validate-artifact.sh then passed the finished plan with 0 warnings on the first run, including its own Tier-Justification measurement check -- no authoring iteration needed.

Scoped batch-gate check (verify-touched.sh, no args) after Phase 2's edit surfaced one EXPECTED run-all failure: check-extension-docs.sh gate3 'deployed script content drift (deployed != extension source): scripts/validate-artifact.sh' inside test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh, annotated by run-all itself as '(1 expected, 0 NEW)'. This is the routine, benign mid-implementation state for any source-store edit made before this plan's own Phase 5 redeploy step -- not a regression from Phase 1/2's logic. Confirmed the check is exactly check-extension-docs.sh's drift-detection gate (grep -n 'deployed script content drift' .claude/scripts/check-extension-docs.sh), not a defect in the new candidate-resolution code.

Scoped batch-gate check after Phase 3's edit again surfaced the same EXPECTED, non-regression failure (check-extension-docs.sh gate3 'deployed script content drift', now naming both scripts/validate-artifact.sh and scripts/tests/test-validate-artifact.sh), run-all-annotated '(1 expected, 0 NEW)'. Routine pre-Phase-5-redeploy state.

Scoped batch-gate check after Phase 4's doc edit surfaced the same gate3 content-drift class, now including index-entries.json's line_count mismatch for repo-level-declarations.md (declared 303, actual 311) -- exactly the drift Phase 4's own task list flagged as scheduled for Phase 5's deploy-headless.sh reconciliation. (1 expected, 0 NEW) per run-all.
